# Teva Pharmaceutical Industries

> > Teva Pharmaceutical Industries is a global leader in generic medicines and biosimilars, committed to improving patient health through accessible treatments and patient support.

Teva operates worldwide with major presence in the United States, Europe, and Israel (NYSE: TEVA, TASE). The company focuses on developing complex medicines, supporting patients with chronic illnesses, and advancing healthcare accessibility through research, clinical trials, and partnerships with organizations like the European Commission and Medicines for Europe.

## Key Topics

- Generic medicines and biosimilars
- Drug development and research
- Clinical trials and respiratory treatments
- Chronic illness management (migraine, asthma, heart failure, mental health)
- Patient advocacy and caregiver support
- Healthcare accessibility and Universal Health Coverage
- Coping strategies for chronic conditions
- European pharmaceutical regulations
- Medicine supply chain resilience
- Corporate governance and leadership
- Patient contributor stories
- Mental health and schizophrenia
- Cardiovascular disease management
- ADHD and invisible illness advocacy
- ESG initiatives in healthcare
